message: 魔王が来たりて悪徳商法

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, a shooting star」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ta-ma-ya!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what that's for」

name: Azel
message: 「What is a 'Tamaya'?」

name: Ria
message: 「Long ago, at a big festival, two firework makers named Tamaya and Kagiya launched fireworks in turns, and Tamaya's were so spectacular that」

name: Ria
message: 「the spectators couldn't help shouting 'Tamaya!', or so the story goes」

name: Azel
message: 「Fireworks, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「There was a photo book of fireworks in the library」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like I'm interested or anything」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I spotted one too! Tamaya~」

name: Synn
message: 「This is also because of Re-Crea, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Azel
message: 「What is going to happen」

name: Synn
message: 「So you are interested?」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san is an officer of the Student Council too, so she probably ought to know at least the basics」

name: Synn
message: 「Even we don't know the details, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just that Demons will start appearing」

name: Misa
message: 「You know a bit more than that, don't you, Senpai?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh, more stuff is going to happen? That's so exciting~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Exciting, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「There's just one thing that's certain」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is it, what is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's something exciting, isn't it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone, gather closer」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, I smell a secret」

name: Misa
message: 「Being this close to Senpai... My heart is pounding」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn! Don't press up against Senpai!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan belongs to yours truly!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sarang-kott!?」

name: Ria
message: 「...When Re-Crea gets closer, you see」

name: Misa & Nanaka
message: 「When it gets closer?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ba-dump...」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp」

name: Ria
message: 「The Demon Lord will come!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeeeek!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hyoh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, come on, you're just trying to scare us like that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san can be quite playful sometimes」

name: Ria
message: 「Muu. It's true! I heard that's what happened during the last Re-Crea too」
The last one means... Dad?

name: Misa
message: 「How can we repel the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why jump to that right away. We could talk things out--」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you saying, Sakura-kun! The Demon Lord is the king of demons! His strength, ferocity, and pervertedness must be on a whole other level from the ones we've faced so far」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Breathing fire from his mouth is practically a given, isn't it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And of course, its dorsal fins glow when it breathes fire」

name: Misa
message: 「Its tough hide is strong enough to deflect even missiles」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It flies through the sky on shining golden wings. Mmm. Having wings when you're not even an angel is simply unforgivable」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I hear it has like seven heads, too」

name: Misa
message: 「Those sharp claws could surely tear a building apart in a single blow! What a terrifying foe! However, we will not lose!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone, um, calm down, the Demon Lord is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-How scary. That's not a movie, that's a real kaiju!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I bet it crunches right through people and eats them. And since it's a million times more perverted than Synn, it kidnaps tons of girls to build a harem too. Total scumbag!」

name: Misa
message: 「For once, I agree with Nanaka-san's opinion. The Demon Lord is still a man, after all. Human scum」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, that's not...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President, that is incorrect. Mr. Demon Lord is not human scum」
Lolotte is defending me!

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. You're all being awful when you don't even know anything」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you know something?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not like that, it's just that talking so badly about someone you don't even know is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, you are mistaken as well. Since the Demon Lord is not human, he cannot be called human scum」

name: Misa
message: 「True. To include him among humans--I still have much to learn」

name: Ria
message: 「You're all being awful! The Demon Lord isn't that bad of a person!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh? Is that so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though he's the Demon Lord?」

name: Ria
message: 「Mother said so herself」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, Ria-senpai, did your mother meet the Demon Lord during the last Re-Crea?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. She said he saved her several times」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that weird? Even though he's the Demon Lord?」

name: Misa
message: 「I mean no disrespect to your mother, Ria-senpai, but was he really the Demon Lord?」

name: Ria
message: 「Apparently, he went out of his way to introduce himself as one」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds shady as hell!」
What on earth are you doing, Dad.

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be... that's your only basis for it?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not true! He was super strong and cool, so it has to be him」

name: Ria
message: 「...At least, that's what Mother said」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was almost certainly all staged」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It was not!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Having underlings attack a target only to purposely rescue them and earn their trust. My guidebook says that's a classic scammer tactic」
No, there's no way. Dad wouldn't even have the imagination to pull off a con.
Though he falls for them all the time.

name: Misa
message: 「H-How utterly despicable! Still, what could he possibly have been planning once he gained her trust?」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen, just because he's called the Demon Lord, you're all jumping to--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You are quite ignorant, Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「From the guidebook again?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gaining someone's trust is the go-to move for criminals--especially con artists」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. Guess that thing actually has some decent info once in a while」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He was undoubtedly trying to hawk something to Senpai's mother. Like Demon Lord toothpaste, a Demon Lord urn, Demon Lord candy, or a Demon Lord encyclopedia」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How cheap」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not cheap!」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister! We swear we shall avenge you against these shady business practices!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Down with the Demon Lord!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」
Urgh. Am I going to be overthrown too...?

name: Ria
message: 「Even though it's not a shady business... *sob*」
